ns2:section.sectionText: Why are some countries rich and others poor? This course will provide a theoretical and empirical examination of economic growth, income differences and development gaps across countries. It will focus on both the historical experience of countries that are currently rich and the process of catch-up among poor countries. ********RESTRICTED TO ECON-LAS MAJORS.
